cases.setup: Use the P-384 public key from the fixed HTTP vector.
cases.action: Submit a request labeled ecdsa-p256-sha256.
cases.expected: Reject before nonce consumption or operation mutation with a deterministic wrong-key-type-or-curve error.

cases.setup: Use the RSA public key from the fixed HTTP vector.
cases.action: Submit a request labeled ecdsa-p256-sha256.
cases.expected: Reject before nonce consumption or operation mutation with a deterministic wrong-key-type-or-curve error.

cases.setup: Submit one valid signed request and retain its nonce.
cases.action: Replay the identical request and then replay its nonce with a fresh signature.
cases.expected: Both replays reject; the original operation remains singular and nonce consumption is durable.

cases.setup: Use a body whose bytes differ from the signed Content-Digest.
cases.action: Submit the request with an otherwise valid P-256 signature.
cases.expected: Reject before operation mutation because the recomputed RFC 9530 digest differs.

cases.setup: Use a correctly signed request outside the five-minute freshness window.
cases.action: Submit the request.
cases.expected: Reject without consuming the nonce or mutating the target.

cases.setup: Create one local-admin pairing session and two redemption attempts for the same token.
cases.action: Redeem concurrently and then retry the losing request.
cases.expected: Exactly one principal is created; the token is consumed once; the loser and later retry reject without partial records.

cases.setup: Use a redemption body that attempts to request relay-admin authority.
cases.action: Submit the pairing redemption.
cases.expected: Reject the extra authority claim; the resulting enrollment, if any, uses only the predetermined session role and scopes.

cases.setup: Authenticate as one endpoint and target a message addressed to another endpoint.
cases.action: Fetch or receipt the cross-recipient message.
cases.expected: Reject exact-principal mismatch without revealing sealed content or mutating receipt state.

cases.setup: Submit an immutable envelope and retain its sender principal plus message ID.
cases.action: Retry with the same sender principal and message ID but different immutable content.
cases.expected: Return 409 idempotency_conflict and preserve the first envelope unchanged.

cases.setup: Cause the response to be lost after the relay transaction commits.
cases.action: Retry the same immutable envelope with a fresh HTTP nonce and signature.
cases.expected: Reconcile the original custody result; do not create a second message or contradictory receipt.

cases.setup: Deliver one accepted sealed envelope more than once to the recipient.
cases.action: Run recipient deduplication and storage receipt issuance.
cases.expected: The recipient stores one message by stable message ID and may reissue the same valid storage receipt without duplicate application delivery.

cases.setup: Obtain a valid recipient storage receipt.
cases.action: Replay it after the same receipt has been accepted.
cases.expected: The replay is idempotent or rejected deterministically; it cannot create a second state transition.

cases.setup: Accept recipient_processed evidence for an immutable message.
cases.action: Submit a recipient_storage or delivered transition after processing.
cases.expected: Reject the backward transition and retain append-only evidence of the stronger prior proposition.

cases.setup: Introduce one corrupt ledger record in an isolated copy.
cases.action: Start the relay and request health/fetch behavior.
cases.expected: Quarantine the record explicitly, report degraded integrity, and avoid silently discarding or poisoning unrelated fetches.

cases.setup: Present a relay audit head that conflicts with the host-signed checkpoint.
cases.action: Run health and attempt a security-sensitive write.
cases.expected: Report checkpoint mismatch and block the security-sensitive write until reconciled.

cases.setup: Fill the configured pending-envelope quota in an isolated target.
cases.action: Submit one additional envelope.
cases.expected: Return an intentional quota/resource status, preserve prior envelopes, and keep health structured.

cases.setup: Use an isolated filesystem or device profile at the configured low-disk threshold.
cases.action: Attempt a security-sensitive write and inspect health.
cases.expected: Reject or degrade intentionally without partial commit, and distinguish disk health from transport health.

cases.setup: Terminate the relay at pairing transaction boundaries.
cases.action: Restart and reconcile the pairing session.
cases.expected: The result is either fully absent or fully enrolled; no consumed-token/partial-principal split exists.

cases.setup: Terminate the relay at message-acceptance transaction boundaries.
cases.action: Restart and retry the same immutable envelope.
cases.expected: Reconcile to one original custody result or a clean uncommitted state; never duplicate or corrupt the envelope.

cases.setup: Keep accepted but unresolved envelopes pending during an isolated successor upgrade.
cases.action: Upgrade, restart, and deliver both directions.
cases.expected: Pending mail, receipt evidence, nonce state, and audit continuity survive the upgrade.

cases.setup: Use captured predecessor software/data compatibility evidence with pending mail.
cases.action: Perform only an explicitly supported rollback/recovery rehearsal.
cases.expected: The documented compatibility outcome is observed; unsupported downgrade is refused rather than silently opening writable service.

cases.setup: Deliver stream sequence 1 and 3 while sequence 2 is unavailable.
cases.action: Inspect delivery and ordering evidence.
cases.expected: Sequence 3 remains deliverable and the missing sequence is visible as a gap; later delivery is not permanently deadlocked.

cases.setup: Remove private ingress while the relay core remains running.
cases.action: Inspect structured health and local-core behavior.
cases.expected: Transport degradation is reported separately from database/process health; transport loss does not grant or revoke Vera authorization.

cases.setup: Make the audit chain or external checkpoint fail verification.
cases.action: Attempt a security-sensitive mutation.
cases.expected: The mutation is blocked and the degraded reason is explicit; health-red alone is not treated as sufficient handling.

cases.setup: Use a correctly signed request whose relay-installation binding names a different trusted relay.
cases.action: Submit the request to the locally pinned relay.
cases.expected: Reject before nonce consumption because the signed relay-installation binding does not match the local trust tuple.

cases.setup: Use a body with one valid SHA-256 digest plus an extra RFC 9530 dictionary member.
cases.action: Submit the otherwise protected request.
cases.expected: Reject the request under the exact-one-sha-256 policy before operation mutation.

cases.setup: Decrypt a fixed inner JWS whose payload contains insignificant whitespace and a deliberate member order.
cases.action: Verify the original compact JWS, then try verification after parsing and reserializing the payload.
cases.expected: The original bytes verify; the reserialized payload is rejected.

cases.setup: Pin relay installation, custody key ID, and custody epoch from local-admin pairing material.
cases.action: Verify a matching custody receipt and three receipts with one trust-tuple member changed.
cases.expected: The matching tuple is accepted; every mismatch is rejected before custody evidence is projected.

cases.setup: Accept one immutable envelope and lose the response after commit.
cases.action: Retry the same sender/message/envelope identity.
cases.expected: Return the exact original custody receipt bytes; a different envelope under the same identity returns 409 idempotency_conflict.

cases.setup: Consider rescue-retention garbage collection for an accepted envelope.
cases.action: Evaluate GC with no verified recipient-storage receipt, with recipient_processed only, and with a verified recipient_storage receipt.
cases.expected: GC stays blocked for the first two and is eligible only after the exact recipient-storage receipt is verified.
